rules.statement: Where a person agrees by notarial deed to sell immovable property to another, the deed does not operate as a sale so as to transfer title, even when delivery of possession of the property and payment of the purchase price have been made. Such a deed is not a deed transferring title but is an agreement relating to the future transfer of title, and title does not pass until a further notarial deed is subsequently executed transferring the title.
